info.title: fathom
info.description: A local-first CLI for logging predictions and measuring how well-calibrated you are. Record predictions with a confidence level, resolve them as they come true or not, and see your Brier score and calibration over time.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: fathom: log predictions and measure how well-calibrated you are

options.name: --confidence
options.description: How confident you are the statement is true (0–100)

options.name: --by
options.description: Date you expect to know the outcome, in your local format (e.g. 12/31/2026)

arguments.name: STATEMENT
arguments.description: The prediction, phrased so it can resolve by yes or no

commands.name: open
commands.description: List every unresolved prediction, dated or not

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Record whether a prediction came true

arguments.name: OUTCOME
arguments.description: Did it happen? yes/no (also y/n, true/false) [default: False]

commands.name: unresolve
commands.description: Reopen a resolved prediction so you can resolve it again

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: Which prediction to send back to open (to fix a wrong resolution)

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Mark a prediction unanswerable so it leaves your lists without scoring

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: Which prediction to cancel (became unanswerable; won't count toward your score)
